SELECT SEQ_SETTLEMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_SETTLEMENT (SETTLEMENT_NO, LAWYER_NO, PAYMENT_NO, CONSULT_DATE, MEMBER_NAME, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, FEE, SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{settlementNo}, #{lawyerNo}, #{paymentNo}, TO_DATE(#{consultDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{memberName}, #{paymentAmount}, #{fee}, #{settlementAmount}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT SETTLEMENT_NO, LAWYER_NO, PAYMENT_NO, TO_CHAR(CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CONSULT_DATE, MEMBER_NAME, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, FEE, SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_SETTLEMENT WHERE LAWYER_NO = #{lawyerNo} AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY')) = #{year} AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(CONSULT_DATE, 'MM')) = #{month} ORDER BY CONSULT_DATE DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS MONTH, SUM(SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT) AS SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT FROM TB_SETTLEMENT WHERE LAWYER_NO = #{lawyerNo} AND CONSULT_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -11) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CONSULT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SETTLEMENT SET STATUS = 'COMPLETED', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SETTLEMENT_NO = #{settlementNo}
